zh.title: 可观测性工程
zh.description: 一本面向现代复杂系统的实践指南，系统解释可观测性为何不同于传统监控，以及团队如何借助结构化事件、分布式追踪、OpenTelemetry、SLO 和组织协作，更快地理解与调试未知问题。
parts: 定义、调试差异、规模化经验，以及与 DevOps / SRE 的关系。
结构化事件、分布式追踪、OpenTelemetry 与事件分析。
可观测性驱动开发、SLO、告警与组织落地。
数据存储、采样、遥测管道与成熟度模型。

en.title: Observability Engineering
en.description: A practical guide to modern, complex systems. It explains how observability differs from traditional monitoring and how teams use structured events, distributed tracing, OpenTelemetry, SLOs, and collaborative practices to debug previously unknown problems.
parts: Definitions, debugging differences, scaling lessons, and DevOps / SRE.
Structured events, distributed tracing, OpenTelemetry, and analysis.
Team adoption, SLOs, alerting, and observability-driven development.
Data stores, sampling, telemetry pipelines, and maturity.

zh.title: 分布式系统可观测性
zh.description: 聚焦分布式系统中的监控难题与取舍，讨论日志、指标和追踪各自的优势与局限，并给出逐步演进观测体系的清晰蓝图。
parts: 从分布式系统复杂度与运营挑战开始。
告警、信号选择与不可监控故障。
面向失败的代码与测试方法。
三类遥测信号的优势、限制与组合。

en.title: Distributed Systems Observability
en.description: A concise guide to monitoring tradeoffs in distributed systems. It compares logs, metrics, and traces, explains partial and soft failures, and offers a clear path for evolving an observability practice.
parts: Alerts, signal selection, and failures that evade monitoring.
Strengths, limitations, and combinations of the three signals.

zh.title: 实施服务级别目标
zh.description: 从用户视角定义有意义的 SLI 和 SLO，使用错误预算推动数据驱动决策，并从零开始建立支持 SLO 的工具、流程与组织文化。
parts: 可靠性堆栈、SLI、目标与错误预算。
组织共识、测量、工具与案例。

en.title: Implementing Service Level Objectives
en.description: Define meaningful SLIs and SLOs from the user perspective, apply error budgets to data-driven decisions, and build the tooling, process, and culture needed to operate an SLO program.
parts: The reliability stack, SLIs, objectives, and error budgets.
Alignment, measurement, tooling, and case studies.

zh.title: 网站可靠性工程
zh.description: Google SRE 团队总结如何以软件工程方法运行大型生产系统，覆盖风险、SLO、自动化、告警、故障响应、容量与组织协作。
parts: Google 生产环境与 SRE 的基本定义。
风险、SLO、消除琐务、监控与自动化。
告警、值班、故障响应、容量与系统设计。
团队成长、协作和参与模式。

en.title: Site Reliability Engineering
en.description: Google SRE practitioners explain how software engineering can operate large production systems, covering risk, SLOs, automation, monitoring, incident response, capacity, and organizational collaboration.
parts: Google production environments and the definition of SRE.
Risk, SLOs, toil reduction, monitoring, and automation.
Alerting, on-call, incident response, capacity, and design.
Team growth, collaboration, and engagement models.

zh.title: SRE 实战手册
zh.description: 《网站可靠性工程》的实践伙伴，以 Google 与多家团队的真实案例说明如何落地 SLO、告警、值班、故障响应、消除琐务和组织变革。
parts: SRE 与 DevOps、SLO 和错误预算。
值班、事故响应、复盘与容量。
SRE 参与模式与变革管理。

en.title: The Site Reliability Workbook
en.description: The hands-on companion to the SRE book, using cases from Google and other organizations to implement SLOs, alerting, on-call, incident response, toil reduction, and organizational change.
parts: SRE and DevOps, SLOs, and error budgets.

zh.title: 构建安全可靠的系统
zh.description: 将安全与可靠性作为同一套系统质量来设计，讨论从架构、变更、恢复到组织协作的工程实践，帮助团队构建可扩展的生产系统。
parts: 安全与可靠性的共同基础。
架构、隔离、最小权限与弹性。
跨团队文化、流程和治理。

en.title: Building Secure & Reliable Systems
en.description: Treat security and reliability as one system quality. The book connects architecture, change, recovery, and organizational collaboration to help teams build scalable and resilient production systems.
parts: The shared foundations of security and reliability.
Architecture, isolation, least privilege, and resilience.
